effects: Pulls `amount` SOLV OFT (the vault collateral 0x7670…f91D) from the signer into the vault via safeTransferFrom; requires a prior approval.
Credits newly minted vault active shares (count derived from vault totals) to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily the signer.
Reverts if the signer is not whitelisted while the whitelist is on, or if the deposit limit is exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 SOLV OFT into the vault, credited to the shown beneficiary address.

findings.title: deposit: number of vault shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown; it is derived from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` `_activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`; descriptor shows only amount and beneficiary.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata; the beneficiary field already states who gets the position.

effects: Burns the signer's active vault shares worth `amount` collateral (rounded up), reducing the signer's staked position.
Queues `amount` SOLV OFT into the next epoch's withdrawals and credits the withdrawal claim to `claimer`, who can claim it after that epoch ends.
The queued amount stays slashable until claimed, so the claimer may later receive less.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 SOLV OFT from the vault, claimable by the shown claim owner.

findings.title: withdraw: shares burned from the signer's position are derived from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` then `_withdraw` reduces `_activeSharesOf[msg.sender]`.
findings.fix: None from calldata; the requested asset amount is the meaningful bound.

findings.title: withdraw: requested amount can be cut by slashing before claim; label does not say 'up to'.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol onSlash reduces `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`; claim pays `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)` pro rata. Descriptor label 'Requested assets'.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the collateral those shares are worth (derived from vault totals) into next epoch's withdrawals, credited to `claimer`.
The queued amount stays slashable until claimed.
formats.shown: Queue a raw integer number of vault shares for withdrawal, claimable by the shown claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: share amount shown as raw 18-decimal integer though shares have collateral decimals.
findings.evidence: ERC4626Math.sol `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18 decimals; descriptor `#.shares` format 'raw'; case 2 shows '987654321123456789'.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with params {"base":"shares","decimals":18} and drop 'raw' from the label and intent.

findings.title: redeem: collateral amount queued for the shares is derived from storage and not shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed (consumes the signer's claim right).
Sends the signer's full claimable SOLV OFT for that epoch (amount from storage) to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 and send it to the shown recipient.

findings.title: claim: screen never names the asset paid out (SOLV OFT) to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Intent 'Claim SOLV OFT withdrawal' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim SOLV OFT for epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: amount paid out is read from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Sends the summed claimable SOLV OFT for those epochs (amounts from storage) to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim withdrawals for the listed epochs and send them to the shown recipient.

findings.title: claimBatch: screen never names the asset paid out (SOLV OFT) to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Intent 'Claim SOLV OFT withdrawals' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim SOLV OFT for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: total amount paid out is read from storage and cannot be shown.
